text: Unlatched (2026-11-02), references in the studio: upload a reference set ONCE and select it from Your Uploads by id per frame (Select Media is a multi-select; tick each tile, Confirm). Uploading per frame piled up 126 duplicates: the UploadImage `uploadId` is not the library's init-image id, and REST DELETE answers 200 for an unknown id, so the "cleanup" deleted nothing. A real delete answers with the id it removed; verify against GetViewerUploads.
